component.name: clear-record
component.summary: Reconstruct one clear record from many recordings

description.p: clear-record is a local-first, open-source multitrack transcription and record-reconstruction tool. It takes several recordings of the same event (a laptop mic, a field recorder, wireless transmitters), normalizes and aligns them, transcribes them with a local model, reconciles the result into an attributable timeline, and exports Markdown, SRT, VTT or JSON.

It is a post-processing tool: the pipeline starts at ingest and does not capture. Processing runs offline once models are provisioned — no cloud processing and no subscription. Recordings and transcripts stay on the machine; model weights are downloaded on first use and never bundled.

ul.li: Normalize and align heterogeneous audio sources onto one clock.
Offline speech recognition with a local GGML model.
Chunked, resumable transcription of long tapes.
Baseline multi-speaker attribution and a glossary initial prompt.
Export to Markdown, SRT, VTT and JSON, with quality metrics.
A local web console for managing projects and glossary tables.

description.p: Second release: platform-native paths (platformdirs), the bundled web console, the PySide6 tray supervisor and desktop bundle, the MCP server, i18n catalogs, and this Flatpak scaffold.
First scaffolded Flatpak packaging: Vulkan whisper.cpp bundled, web console launcher, AppStream metadata.
